body:
## [3.62.0] - 2026-08-13

### Features

- improve sales employee cache update logic for repair orders
- add sales employee name to repair order summary and detail panel
- combine notes from customer info and parts steps in repair line flow
- send sales employee to repair order creation and show it on repair slip
- add support for dynamic currency symbols in report builders

### Bug Fixes

- localize gift card status labels
- block read-only activation submit
- surface foreign-currency cash opening balance in Z/X reports

### Other Changes

- Fix gift card existing status dialog
